# tally — Plans & Pricing

tally is free to use on your own machine. The plans below apply only to the hosted
backup add-on, which is optional.

## Plans

| Plan | Price | Expenses per month | Backup history |
|------|-------|--------------------|----------------|
| Free | $0 | up to 100 | 7 days |
| Plus | $3 / month | unlimited | 1 year |
| Family | $6 / month | unlimited | 3 years |

## Notes

- The **Free** plan lets you record up to **100 expenses per month**. If you record
  more, the extra expenses are still saved locally; they are simply not included in
  the hosted backup until you upgrade.
- Prices are in US dollars and billed monthly. There is no annual plan yet.
- Upgrading or downgrading takes effect at the start of the next billing month.

If the published limit here ever changes, remember that `docs/faq.md` quotes the
same number and has to be updated to match (see requirements R6).

# tally — Frequently Asked Questions

## Is tally really free?

Yes. Running tally on your own computer is free and always will be. The only thing
that costs money is the optional hosted backup add-on.

## How many expenses can I track on the free plan?

The free plan includes hosted backup for up to **100 expenses per month**. You can
record more than that locally — nothing stops you — but only the first 100 in a
month are covered by the free backup. The Plus and Family plans remove the limit.

## Where is my data kept?

In a single JSON file on your own machine. Unless you turn on the hosted backup
add-on, your data never leaves your computer.

## Can I enter expenses in other currencies?

Yes. Pass `--currency` when you add an expense and tally converts it to US dollars
for you.
